title: Canonical pay-to-singleton: announcement bridge
security_scope: Exact canonical pay-to-singleton raw-domain port, with five independent builds and canonical Eve/lineage announcement composition. The singleton top layer and StandardLayer are canonical host counterparts, not Rust ports. Finite validation is not production readiness, compiler preservation or completion of the singleton protocol.

license.scope: Exact repository license retained; no independent per-file legal review.

commit.verification: Retained raw commit content checked against its Git object ID; no local PGP trust claim.

tree.scope: Complete pinned Git tree; source/include/license/artifact blob membership checked.

source_adaptation.description: The exact pinned whole module is retained unchanged; no typed-argument wrapper is added.

provenance.module_identity_obligation: Independently reproduce the exact published artifact, then record actual emitted bytes/hashes without changing the canonical identity. Behavioral agreement does not imply module identity.
limitations: The canonical module is reproduced independently; Rust and Rue artifacts have distinct module hashes.
Module/inner/my_id accept exact arbitrary-width atoms; launcher fields are arbitrary trees; dotted structure and ignored environment tail are preserved.

Canonical top layer and signed StandardLayer are host counterparts, not additional Rust ports. Finite Eve and subsequent-lineage spends do not establish all singleton lifecycle, wallet or security properties.
